The 21st PMPC Star Awards for Movies by the Philippine Movie Press Club (PMPC), honored the best Filipino films of 2004. The ceremony took place on March 12, 2005 in Gateway Mall, Araneta in Cubao, Quezon City.
Milan  won the top awards including Movie of the Year and Movie Director of the Year.
Winners
The following are the nominations for the 21st PMPC Star Awards for Movies, covering films released in 2004.
Winners are listed below.
* Movie of the Year
** Milan
* Movie Director of the Year
** Olivia Lamasan for Milan
* Movie Actor of the Year
** Dennis Trillo for Aishite Imasu 1941: Mahal Kita
* Movie Actress of the Year
** Vilma Santos for Mano Po III: My Love
* Movie Supporting Actor of the Year
** Jay Manalo (tied) for Aishite Imasu 1941: Mahal Kita
** John Lloyd Cruz (tied) for Dubai
* Movie Supporting Actress of the Year
** Ara Mina for Minsan Pa
* New Movie Actor of the Year
** Dennis Trillo' for Aishite Imasu 1941: Mahal Kita
* Movie Theme Song of the Year
** Ikaw Lamang - composer by Ogie Alcasid and interpreted by Gary Valenciano'
